key_idea: Use a monoid of diagrams in a symmetric forcing construction to control availability fibers and residual symmetries, coherently selecting bijections to make every nonwellorderable surjective image of a generic set equipotent with it.
reason: The proof features a brilliant and highly surprising conceptual core to resolve a notoriously difficult problem. However, this elegant central strategy is necessarily embedded within immense technical bookkeeping and a long, intricate chain of lemmas to rigorously execute the symmetric forcing construction.
recognized: The Partition Principle does not imply the Axiom of Choice (recent preprint)
